latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of amazon-backend-keywords skill.

- Generates optimized Amazon backend keyword sets for maximum discoverability.
- Automatically deduplicates, prioritizes, and formats up to 250 bytes of backend keywords excluded from existing listings.
- Supports multiple e-commerce platforms: Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Etsy, eBay, and BigCommerce.
- Features: keyword deduplication, relevance prioritization, multilingual support, synonym/misspelling coverage, prohibited term filtering, and before/after coverage comparison.
- Provides structured, actionable recommendations and benchmarks.
